READ: President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. calls on Filipinos to draw inspiration from the lives and sacrifices of departed loved ones and the saints as the country observes All Saints’ Day and All Souls’ Day. “If we can make time to revere those who have passed, we can also make room to listen to those who struggle, and let that same concern guide our society and the work of government," he says in his message for #Undas2026. | @dexcabalzaINQ
